caption: The drawing contains a variety of objects arranged in a symmetrical, decorative composition. At the top are three yellow pillars acting as pedestals, each with geometric patterns and holding potted plants featuring long green leaves and large, red-and-yellow stylized flowers with circular and pointed petals. In the center, on a pedestal between the pillars, sits a red, urn-like vessel with yellow accent details and a yellow crown. Below this is a large green wreath at the center of the drawing, adorned with a yellow-and-red bow at the top. Inside the wreath and around it, there is German calligraphy in black ink, also present throughout the lower half of the image. Surrounding the central text and wreath are more stylized flowers in red, orange, blue, and yellow, along with green leafy stems. The bottom of the composition includes various tulip-like and abstract flowers, leaves, and buds in similarly bright colors, with the arrangement creating a frame around the text. The entire image uses a palette of red, yellow, green, blue, and orange, with delicate black ink line work for detail and text.
title: Baptismal Certificate
